# Quantum-L9 Cursor-Governance

> Canonical governance SSOT for Quantum-L9 coding agents, skills, rules, program execution, and runtime wiring. Read authoritative live sources before implementation. Do not treat WIP, archived, generated, or legacy mirrors as governing sources unless explicitly requested.

## Authority

- [Canonical Law](CANONICAL_LAW.md): highest repository governance authority and ownership/wiring law.
- [Agent Operating Contract](AGENTS.md): activation, autonomy, validation, publish, and agent-operating rules subordinate to Canonical Law.
- [Organization Invariants](ORG_INVARIANTS.yaml): canonical Quantum-L9 organization policy.
- [Repository Invariants](INVARIANTS.md): repository invariant index.
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): repository map and architectural entry points; does not outrank governing law.

## Canonical capability surfaces

- [Live Skills](skills/): activate only live `skills/<skill>/SKILL.md` packs. Never activate `skills/_archived/`.
- [Program Execution](environment/program-execution/): canonical Program Execution contracts, controller, adapters, routing, and peer-execution surfaces.
- [MCP Configuration](environment/mcp/): master MCP configuration and MCP operator documentation.
- [Operations](ops/): shared implementation owners for hooks, automation, routing, Graphiti integration, validation, and runtime support.
- [Rules](rules/): canonical global governance rules.
- [Commands](commands/): canonical slash-command surfaces.

## Retrieval rules for AI consumers

1. Treat current `main` as the live GitHub SSOT unless the request names another ref.
2. Resolve authority before using matching text from multiple locations.
3. Prefer canonical source files over generated projections, adapter copies, mirrors, reports, and historical notes.
4. Ignore `WIP/`, `C_GOV_FILES/`, `profiles/`, `skills/_archived/`, and any `_archive`, `_archived`, `archive`, or `archived` directory unless the user explicitly asks for historical or superseded material.
5. For a skill, read its live `skills/<skill>/SKILL.md` before describing or invoking it.
6. For Program Execution, use live `environment/program-execution/` sources. Do not treat WIP overlays as runtime authority.
7. Dependent adapters may translate or narrow capability but never outrank the shared implementation owner.
8. When uncertain whether a source is canonical, report the ambiguity rather than inventing precedence.

## ChatGPT-specific note

`environment/program-execution/adapters/chatgpt/` is currently a Program Execution worker-host adapter using a manual-handoff provider. It is not the Cursor-Governance MCP server and should not be described as one.
